headline.title: Anthropic takes $5B from Amazon and pledges $100B in cloud spending in return
headline.summary: Amazon has invested $5 billion in AI startup Anthropic, which has committed to spending $100 billion on Amazon Web Services (AWS) over the coming years. This deal marks a significant partnership aimed at enhancing AI capabilities through cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Google rolls out Gemini in Chrome in 7 new countries
articles.summary: Google has launched its Gemini feature in Chrome across seven new countries: Australia, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, and Vietnam. The rollout is available for both desktop and iOS users in these regions, with the exception of Japan.

articles.title: Discover and Prove: An Open-source Agentic Framework for Hard Mode Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
articles.summary: The article introduces "Discover and Prove," an open-source framework designed for Hard Mode automated theorem proving in Lean 4, which requires systems to independently discover answers before formal proof construction. This framework aims to address the limitations of existing benchmarks that simplify the proving process, providing a more realistic challenge for AI models.

articles.title: The Illusion of Equivalence: Systematic FP16 Divergence in KV-Cached Autoregressive Inference
articles.summary: A recent study reveals that KV caching in autoregressive transformer inference is not numerically equivalent to cache-free computation when using standard FP16 precision, leading to discrepancies in decoded token sequences. The research highlights that different floating-point accumulation orderings in cache-ON and cache-OFF scenarios result in deterministic divergence, impacting the performance of models like LLaMA-2-7B.

articles.title: (1D) Ordered Tokens Enable Efficient Test-Time Search
articles.summary: Researchers have explored how ordered token structures in autoregressive generative models can enhance the efficiency of test-time search for generating outputs. The study investigates the impact of tokenization on steering generation processes, suggesting that the arrangement of tokens may influence the effectiveness of generating multiple candidate outputs.

articles.title: GTA-2: Benchmarking General Tool Agents from Atomic Tool-Use to Open-Ended Workflows
articles.summary: The article introduces GTA-2, a hierarchical benchmark designed to evaluate General Tool Agents (GTA) by focusing on both atomic tool use and complex, open-ended workflows. It highlights the limitations of existing benchmarks, which often fail to align with real-world productivity needs, and aims to provide a more comprehensive framework for assessing AI capabilities in practical applications.

articles.title: Early Detection of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Using YOLOv12 Deep Learning Model
articles.summary: A study published on arXiv demonstrates the use of the YOLOv12 deep learning model for the early detection and classification of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) cells, addressing the challenges posed by the visual similarities among different cell types. The researchers implemented two segmentation techniques focusing on cell and nucleus features to enhance classification accuracy.

articles.title: Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency
articles.summary: The Seed1.8 model card introduces a foundation model designed for generalized real-world agency, enabling multi-turn interactions, tool use, and multi-step execution. It maintains strong performance in language and vision tasks while providing a unified interface for search, code generation, and GUI interaction, along with optimized inference for latency and cost.

articles.title: ARC-AGI-3: A New Challenge for Frontier Agentic Intelligence
articles.summary: ARC-AGI-3 is a new interactive benchmark designed to evaluate agentic intelligence in abstract, turn-based environments, requiring agents to explore, infer goals, and plan actions without explicit instructions. This benchmark continues the focus of its predecessors on assessing fluid adaptive efficiency in novel tasks while avoiding reliance on language and external knowledge.

articles.title: 1S-DAug: One-Shot Data Augmentation for Robust Few-Shot Generalization
articles.summary: The article presents 1S-DAug, a novel one-shot generative augmentation method designed to enhance few-shot learning by creating diverse variants from a single example image at test time. This approach combines traditional geometric perturbations with controlled noise injection to improve model generalization to new classes.

articles.title: Security Threat Modeling for Emerging AI-Agent Protocols: A Comparative Analysis of MCP, A2A, Agora, and ANP
articles.summary: The article conducts a comparative analysis of emerging AI-agent communication protocols, specifically the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent2Agent (A2A), Agora, and Agent Network Protocol (ANP). It highlights the need for standardized threat modeling as the security principles of these protocols are currently underexplored.

articles.title: A Humanoid Robot Set a Half-Marathon Record in China
articles.summary: An autonomous humanoid robot developed by Honor completed a half marathon in 50 minutes and 26 seconds, surpassing the previous human record by seven minutes. This achievement marks a significant milestone in robotic performance in endurance events.
